question: Which of the following raw materials is NOT used to prepare the baking soda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Na₂CO₃**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Baking soda, chemically known as **sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃)**, is prepared using sodium chloride (NaCl) as a primary raw material.
 
• The **Solvay process** is the most common method for manufacturing baking soda, which involves the reaction of NaCl, NH₃ (ammonia), and CO₂ in water (H₂O).
 
• **Na₂CO₃ (sodium carbonate)**, also known as washing soda, is not directly used in the preparation of baking soda.
 
• Instead, sodium bicarbonate is derived as an intermediate product in the Solvay process, and Na₂CO₃ is formed as the final byproduct, not as a starting raw material.
 
• Therefore, **Na₂CO₃** is not a raw material used in the manufacturing of baking soda.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solvay Process:**

 
 
• The Solvay process is an industrial method used to produce sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) and sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃).
 
• It involves the reaction of sodium chloride (NaCl), ammonia (NH₃), and carbon dioxide (CO₂) in water.
 
• The intermediate product, sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃), is filtered out and heated to produce Na₂CO₃.
 
 
 
• **Baking Soda (NaHCO₃):**
 
 
• Baking soda is a white crystalline compound used as a leavening agent in baking.
 
• It releases carbon dioxide (CO₂) gas when it reacts with acids or heats, causing baked goods to rise.
 
• It is also widely used for cleaning, deodorizing, and pH regulation in various applications.
 
 
 
• **Sodium Carbonate (Na₂CO₃):**
 
 
• Also known as washing soda, it is primarily used in laundry detergents, water softening, and glass manufacturing.
 
• It is not a direct component in the preparation of baking soda but is a final byproduct in the Solvay process.
 
 
 
• **Ammonia (NH₃):**
 
 
• Ammonia is a key raw material in the Solvay process, playing a crucial role in precipitating sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃).
 
• It is recovered and reused in the process to minimize waste and reduce costs.
 
 
 
• **Carbon Dioxide (CO₂):**
 
 
• CO₂ is another essential raw material in the Solvay process, reacting with ammonia and sodium chloride to form sodium bicarbonate.
 
• It ensures the chemical reaction necessary for the production of baking soda.
